275181049.description: This vintage Bradley 'The Yankee Clipper' pen and pencil set includes both chrome-plated writing instruments featuring a ribbed design and an enamel eagle emblem marked 'FOE' (Fraternal Order of Eagles). The set comes with its original presentation box and informational insert. Both pen and pencil are in very good, possibly unused condition, with bright chrome finishes and a clean case. Also included is a Middle Eastern-style wooden desktop organizer with intricate inlaid patterns in green, gold, and black, brass pen holders, a letter holder, and a small front drawer. The bottom of the organizer has a wood finish with felt pads. This set is suited for collectors or those interested in fraternal organization memorabilia.

275249769.description:
Product Overview:
This lot includes a variety of collectible rocks, minerals, and crystals. Specimens featured include clear quartz points, an amethyst cluster, agate slices, geodes, and other mineral fragments such as jasper and calcite. Some stones are shaped or polished, and there are a few painted stones including one painted as a ladybug. Fossil-bearing rocks are also part of the collection.

Specifications:
- Tallest pillar tower measures approximately 4.5 inches
- Variety of colors, textures, and natural formations
- Includes both raw and polished specimens
- Contains painted stones and fossil-bearing rocks
